item.title: Hexdrums: First Noodle (No talk, no drive)
item.description: video upload by Richard DeHove "You want easy? Hexdrums is easy. The sounds are whatever the knobs are on. There are no hidden extra sound controls. The sequencer is wonderfully straightforward yet has the options to create long and complex passages on a single pattern. This is my first pattern with Hexdrums and I created it to learn the options, so it contains a little bit of everything. Voices
